newsitem.title: UK: Norway's Gullfaks crude to load 24 cargoes in Marc.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Gullfaks crude to load 24 cargoes in Marc.

text.p: Norway's Gullfaks crude system is scheduled to load 24 standard 850,000-barrel cargoes in March, two more than the 22 expected to load in February, traders said.
The number of cargoes in March includes two cargoes loading across the end of the month between March 30 and April 1, they said.
The total volume of crude to load in March is 20.4 million barrels, compared to 18.7 million in February, but the increase is simply due to the extra three days in the month, the traders said.
